name: si-tax-overview
description: Slovenia tax overview for tax year 2026: who is taxed and on what, the 2026 income tax scale (16% to 50%) and general allowance, capital income at 25%, corporate income tax at 22% for 2024 to 2028, VAT at 22%, 9.5% and 5% with the EUR 60,000 small business exemption, social contribution rates, the 2026 rules for sole proprietors on normed expenses (ZPZR), the winter allowance, and the main filing dates. Use it as the first stop for any Slovenian tax question, then open the domain skill it points to.
